WITH family AS (
  SELECT product_family_id FROM product_families WHERE product_family_name = 'Bosch Professional BBS 1P7-CG5 Automotive Charger and Bulb line'
),
matching AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN family ON pv.product_family_id = family.product_family_id
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'product type' AND property_value_text = 'battery pack')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'voltage' AND property_value_text = '12 V')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'current' AND property_value_text = '16 A')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'wifi-enabled' AND property_value_text = 'yes')
),
base AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN family ON pv.product_family_id = family.product_family_id
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'product type' AND property_value_text = 'battery pack')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'voltage' AND property_value_text = '12 V')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'current' AND property_value_text = '16 A')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'wifi-enabled' AND property_value_text = 'yes')
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT product_family_id FROM family) AS family_id,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM matching LIMIT 1) AS matching_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM matching LIMIT 1) AS matching_record_path,
  (SELECT product_name FROM matching LIMIT 1) AS matching_product_name,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM base LIMIT 1) AS base_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM base LIMIT 1) AS base_record_path;
